text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hear ye, hear ye! Outta my way!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Born and raised in the downtown 
shitamachi! A true-blue Edokko, Inari, 
that's who I am!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"We've got a lo~ng road ahead of us 
starting now, so once again, I'm countin' 
on ya, Boss!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"We've got a lo~ng road ahead of us 
starting now, so once again, I'm countin' 
on ya, Big Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pick a massive brawl on the 
Twinkle stage and make a huge-ass flower 
bloom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
